apis.name: Order
apis.description: The order method is used to submit a Valuation order to the PSX and begin the valuation workflow.

apis.name: Panel Lookup
apis.description: The Panel is used determine which Valuation firm a job will be assigned to and for what fee. When a lender is onboarded onto ValEx, a panel is established based on a lenders authorised Valuation firms, and the fees they negotiate with the firms. For a given estimated market value, postcode and property type, the fee will be the same regardless of which firm is selected. Note that there is still the possibility that the fee may change at a later stage in the workflow due to higher fee requests or Valuation type changes. Also note that in some circumstances a fixed fee is unable to be determined. In these circumstances the panel will return 'quote' indicating the job will go through a quoting process once ordered. The quote process is performed by email, please see Ordering overview for details.
